# Realistic forest CC0 source pool

## Kenney Nature Kit 2.1
- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- OpenGameArt mirror: https://opengameart.org/content/nature-kit
- License: CC0 1.0
- 330+ nature objects: trees, foliage, rocks, terrain, water, camping props and related nature pieces.
- Role: reusable lightweight forest library and mobile fallback/proxy source.

## Poly Haven Pine Forest
- Source: https://polyhaven.com/collections
- Collection: Pine Forest
- License: CC0 1.0
- Role: realistic production-source pool for trees, forest floor, rocks, bark/foliage materials and HDRI references.
- High-resolution source files are deliberately not mirrored wholesale into Git. Promote game-sized derivatives only after texture/geometry budgets are chosen.

Warehouse rule: never delete the stylized/low-poly library when realistic assets are added. Assets can be reused by other games.
